records.text: Erika Kirk competed in the Miss USA pageant at Planet Hollywood in Las Vegas on May 30, 2012.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So she shifted her major at some point. And then Erika, because she qualifies, is going to compete in the Miss USA pageant on May 30th. And I believe that that is in Vegas. ... So here she is competing. It says at the Planet Hollywood Resort and Casino Theater, very appropriate, performing arts in Las Vegas.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous pageant coverage identifies May 30, 2012 as the Miss USA preliminary competition at Planet Hollywood and includes Erika Frantzve as Arizona's delegate; the televised final followed on June 3.
